breaking_news.headline: As budgets tighten, people are breaking out their library cards
breaking_news.summary: Some Americans squeezed by high prices are relying more on their local libraries for things like books, streaming services and high-priced items like musical instruments and sewing machines.

breaking_news.headline: First-time homebuyers remain scarce, but a record share of them pay all cash
breaking_news.summary: A new report finds generational wealth is widening the divide between homebuyers and those priced out. The median age of first-time buyers also remains at a record high.

breaking_news.headline: Pasture mealybugs have killed off huge swaths of grasses in the Southeast
breaking_news.summary: An invasive insect that's tough to detect and eliminate poses a multi-billion dollar threat to the agricultural economy — adding another stressor to farmers already stretched by high costs.

breaking_news.headline: Fears of an AI crackdown after midterms spark $2 trillion rout in tech stocks
breaking_news.summary: Shares sank, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq dropping over 5%, as investors reacted with fear that a Democratic Congress — and states across the country -— would crack down on AI and data centers.

breaking_news.headline: Why gold prices are surprisingly low
breaking_news.summary: Gold tends to go up when there's uncertainty in the economy. For a while, the price reflected that. But this week, it dropped from a nearly $5,600 in January to below $4,000. What's going on?

breaking_news.headline: Hiring jumps: The economy added 165,000 jobs last month
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. job market improved last month, according to a report from the Labor Department Friday.  Employers added more jobs than forecasters had expected and the unemployment rate dipped to 4.1%.

breaking_news.headline: This was the week the AI trade cracked. So what's next?
breaking_news.summary: Big losses by AI shares in stock markets after Democrats won the midterm elections have left investors shaken and wondering comes next.

breaking_news.headline: The Cybertruck's 'cause of death?' Insufficient demand
breaking_news.summary: One of the most polarizing vehicles to hit the road will soon be a thing of history. Tesla will wind down manufacturing of its Cybertruck at the company's Gigafactory Texas mid-next year.

breaking_news.headline: Cornell faculty pass no-confidence vote over leadership's handling of Jane Doe allegations
breaking_news.summary: Friday's resolution by academic staff is largely symbolic as they do not have the power to remove those in charge of the university.

breaking_news.headline: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster
breaking_news.summary: Prosecutors begin investigating EU funds meant for upgrading the Spanish railway line where a train crash killed 69 people.

breaking_news.headline: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people
breaking_news.summary: Paul Mackenzie ordered his followers to starve their children to death in a forest so they could "meet Jesus".

breaking_news.headline: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña impeached and arrested
breaking_news.summary: Santiago Peña was ousted due to a banking crisis which left millions of people unable to access their money.

breaking_news.headline: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
breaking_news.summary: No link has been established between the threats against the airlines and those against the media outlets.

breaking_news.headline: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
breaking_news.summary: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.

breaking_news.headline: Four midterms takeaways for 2028 White House race
breaking_news.summary: The buzz about the presidential election is already under way - here's what we learned this week.

breaking_news.headline: 'I was asked if I was a crier': Your worst job interviews revealed
breaking_news.summary: Bad job interviews can be horrible to experience in the moment, but there is a lot they can teach us about the world of work

breaking_news.headline: PM tells firms to publish salaries in job adverts ahead of new law
breaking_news.summary: The government argues the change will help jobseekers and could help to prevent pay discrimination.

breaking_news.headline: The engine parts that 'fight the laws of the universe'
breaking_news.summary: Investment has surged into the making of jet turbine blades - an extremely difficult component to make.

breaking_news.headline: Elon Musk appears to signal the end of the road for Cybertruck
breaking_news.summary: Musk said it was to make room for production of its Cybercabs - autonomous taxis without a driver.

breaking_news.headline: Why smoky bacon crisps threaten to reignite rows over EU rules
breaking_news.summary: A post-Brexit deal on food standards has raised questions over the future naming of the classic British snack.
